subject: TidalWorks vendor onboarding — PO telemetry and line item change
messages:
From: Elena Marsh <elena@tidalworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@tidalworks.com
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the onboarding call this morning. Attached is the completed vendor onboarding form and our initial invoice schedule. Could you confirm the PO number that Redwood will assign and the effective spend cap while we complete procurement? We expect first invoicing to cover three line items: implementation (SKU: TW-IMP), monthly service (SKU: TW-SRV), and one-off telemetry integration (SKU: TW-INT).

A couple of quick asks:
- We need the PO number to put on our invoice (remit to: TidalWorks, Inc., 48 Harbor Lane, San Diego, CA).
- Can you confirm if the spend cap will be provisional until contract countersign?
- Also, if we need to correct line item quantities after submission, what is the fastest path?

I've attached the onboarding form (TidalWorks_onboarding_form.pdf).

Best,
Elena Marsh
Head of Finance, TidalWorks
elena@tidalworks.com

[Attachment: TidalWorks_onboarding_form.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the form and for laying out the SKUs. Quick clarifications before we provision:
1) Billing / remit name: is the exact legal entity TidalWorks, Inc. (you listed San Diego address) — we need the W-9/TIN to finalize.
2) For the SKU mapping, can you confirm whether TW-INT is a one-time charge (implementation hours) or an ongoing line?
3) If you anticipate changing quantities, let us know the max delta you might request so we can check against the provisional cap.

Priyom / Connor — can procurement provision a provisional PO here while Elena provides TIN? If so, can you include a provisional spend cap and expiration?

Elena — we can accelerate this if you send the W-9 (redacted SSN fine) and a quick confirmation on the TW-INT billing cadence.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Marsh <elena@tidalworks.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Kim / Connor —

I've reviewed the onboarding form. We can issue a provisional PO immediately to unblock invoicing with the following parameters:
- Provisional PO: PO-7890 (provisional)
- Provisional spend cap: USD 75,000
- Expiration: 2026-12-31 (or earlier if final contract/PO is issued)

Notes on line items:
- For TW-INT please confirm whether it's a one-time fixed fee or time & materials. If it's T&M we'll need a not-to-exceed amount per month.
- If TidalWorks needs a quantity bump after the PO is active, procurement can approve an amendment up to +10% under provisional cap without re-issuing, provided the legal entity / TIN matches and the invoice matches our ledger tags. Larger changes require a PO amendment or re-issuance.

Action items:
1) Elena — please send W-9/TIN and confirm TW-INT cadence (one-time vs monthly).
2) Kimberly — I'll attach the provisional PO stub to this thread and create a drive folder for the onboarding artifacts.

Attaching: provisional_ponum_7890.txt (contains PO metadata and ledger tags). DocuSign link will be generated if/when the contract needs countersign.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

[Attachment: provisional_ponum_7890.txt]

From: Elena Marsh <elena@tidalworks.com>

Cc: accounts@tidalworks.com

Subject: Re: Requesting PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Thanks Priyom — that works for us. Quick updates:
- W-9 and our TIN attached to this reply (redacted copy).
- TW-INT is a one-time implementation fee; expected invoice ~USD 18,500.
- We do need to increase quantity on line item TW-SRV for month 1 (new seat add-on) — that's +15% on month 1 only.

I attached a short spreadsheet with the requested delta (lineitem_delta_request.xlsx). Can the +15% be covered under the provisional cap? If not, please advise the fastest path: temporary cap increase vs PO amendment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena

[Attachment: lineitem_delta_request.xlsx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Priyom — quick internal approval note: I can authorize a one-time provisional cap increase to cover the +15% month-1 delta while final contract is processed. Proposed temporary cap: USD 82,000 (to include 10% buffer for invoice rounding). Please:
- Mark PO-7890 as updated (temp_cap=82000, cap_effective=2026-06-15, cap_expires=2026-07-15)
- Add ledger tag: acct:onboard-TW-0418
- Confirm if accounting needs a separate amendment doc for the invoice to process (Elena, CC'd).

Elena — once Priyom confirms the temp cap change, you can go ahead and submit the invoice with PO-7890 and updated line items. We'll fast-track payment.

Thanks all,
Kimberly Park
